expectations.buyer: 3D-printer owners, print farms, service bureaus, repair studios, and slicer vendors
expectations.pain: Nominal dimensions produce different fits across printer, material, nozzle, orientation, and environment
expectations.strongestIncumbent: Slicer compensation, calibration models, test coupons, printer profiles, metrology, and operator experience
expectations.biggestRisk: Profiles drift with wear and environment and incumbents can bundle calibration; repeat willingness to pay is unknown
